purpose: Operational comparability of batch 32 against reference batch 8 on the exact pinned full-HBQ stack; not human accuracy, generalization, or release proof.

selection.key: SHA256(UTF8(seed + U+0000 + opaque_story_id)), lowercase hex; sort by key then opaque_story_id and take first three. No human ratings, condition, topic, or model outcomes enter selection.
selection.continuity: Retain the original label-independent calibration cohort and seed; do not reroll to select easier stories after the prior output-format failure.

question_set.order: Exact pinned runner compiled_questions order after its stable hard_gate/domain/penalty/supplemental ordering; contiguous chunks with the final short chunk retained.

schedule: Reference size 8 first, then size 32; within each size iterate repetitions 1..3, then cohort order, then contiguous batch order. No overlapping unreviewed cohorts.

execution_bounds.precontact: Outer runner hook pauses before attempt-start if an exact prepared prompt is outside the reviewed cohort. Broker admission repeats the exact source/prompt/schema/route checks while holding the host slot. Fresh usage evidence and independent review are required for each next bounded cohort; no implicit carryover.

admission: All 18 complete passes must retain 178 unique validated outcomes, native request/session identities, exact question/source/prompt commitments, finite canonical final_score.observed, and coverage >=0.88. No recovered transport failures, resends, missing, duplicate, or unadmitted items. Every native receipt must be independently replayable.

comparability.leaf_disagreement: For two passes of the same story, count unequal canonical verdict strings over all 178 fixed IDs and divide by 178. Include every verdict category without collapsing or filtering.
comparability.reference_instability: Arithmetic mean disagreement across all three unordered pairs of the three reference passes.
comparability.candidate_instability: Arithmetic mean disagreement across all three unordered pairs of the three candidate passes.
comparability.cross_size_disagreement: Arithmetic mean disagreement across all nine reference-candidate pass pairs; no optimal or outcome-chosen pairing.
comparability.score_shift: Absolute difference between the reference and candidate three-pass mean canonical final_score.observed for each story.
comparability.candidate_gate: For every one of the three stories, cross_size_disagreement <= reference_instability + 0.05 AND candidate_instability <= reference_instability + 0.05 AND score_shift <= 5.0 points on 0..100.
comparability.interpretation: These are prespecified engineering tolerances, not statistical equivalence or accuracy thresholds. Report absolute within-size instability and all score distributions even if the comparative gate passes. Weak repeatability remains a limitation.

cap_rule: If all admission and comparability gates pass, cap=32; if all admission gates pass but comparability fails, cap=8. Otherwise cap=null. Never infer a larger cap or carry this proof to different prompts, tasks, runtime, sampler, or model mapping.
failure_policy: Any provider ambiguity, billing/quota failure, or invalid native output stops the campaign. Preserve terminal cells and bound evidence. No automatic resend, fallback, replacement pass, or downward retry after such a failure.
alignment_measurement: Qualification outputs never substitute for the later fresh one-pass 236-story Grok measurement, including these three TRAIN stories. Keep distinct purpose and logical sample IDs; no favorable-pass selection or pooling.

predecessor.reason: The prior schema permitted a placeholder question ID. This prospective version constrains each batch schema to its requested IDs and minimum item count. It does not repair, resume or relabel the prior attempt.
